description:
Job location Bucharest or Brasov | Fully office-based for the first 6 months, followed by a hybrid setup | Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00.
 
Role summary
 
Join our Accounts Payable team and support accurate and timely invoice processing. You will work with supplier invoices and use applications such as Oracle and SAP to support day-to-day financial operations.
 
Your mission

  • Process supplier invoices accurately and on time;
  • Receive and analyze invoices from suppliers;
  • Work in applications such as Excel and SAP;
  • Register invoices and help ensure payments are completed on time.



Job Qualifications

Required Qualifications


  • Greek & English - B2 level;
  • High school diploma mandatory;
  • Ability to understand finance processes and apply logical thinking to daily activities;
  • Motivation to learn and develop within a finance operations environment.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Previous experience in finance or a financial process;
  • Bachelor's degree, ideally in finance area;
  • Minimum experience in finance, accounting, or invoice processing.


Employee Benefits — Be well, work well, live well


  • Private medical and dental coverage through Regina Maria;
  • Flexible benefits package via Benefit Online, including vouchers, transportation, wellness, and cultural activities;
  • 23 vacation days, with additional days awarded through our loyalty program;
  • Additional private pension plan starting from the second month of employment;
  • Access to extensive learning, training, and career development opportunities;
  • Well-being support, including psychological counseling and premium wellness apps;
  • Life insurance coverage for you and your loved ones;
  • Flexible working hours, depending on project requirements.
